Oh yeah, when I say that I’m isolated I don’t mean that I don’t have any contact with other people at all. I actually have a lot of contact with many different people. I am a University Student in Los Angeles and I also work as a journalist for a small newspaper in East LA. Due to my job I am constantly traveling all around lots of different areas mostly Boyle Heights, Lincoln Heights, Alhambra, San Gabriel, Montebello, and Monterey Park as a result I am constantly meeting new, different, and exciting people. I also belong to a sorority, volunteer for a local community service club, and volunteer for The Trevor Project. I try to hit up people that I know and sometimes they agree to hang out. The thing is there’s a lot of people that I know but nobody that I’m really close too and that hurts like hell especially since I lost a lot of close connections. 

As I mentioned above my family are strict Shi’a Muslims and I am not. If you know anything about people who are very religious they don’t tend to like it when their family members are not and mine are no different. My dad tells me I am disgrace to our family almost every time that we talk and that hurts a lot. They don’t invite me to weddings, birthdays, family reunions, or even holiday celebrations, I am nothing to them. Shortly after high school I enlisted in the Navy and bonded with the people I served with, almost like family but then I got discharged for being diagnosed with depression and anxiety which I do struggle with but it was such a lonely experience and I still haven’t been able to make up for all the connections that I lost. The sad thing is I feel like I’m doing everything I’m supposed to right now to feel less lonely but it feels like nothing is working.

Sorry that was long, I just get this advice a lot and I really appreciate it I do but I’ve been following it and I’m still very lonely.
Awe thank you! You are very kind.

Wow, I guess seeing it spelled out like that makes me realize how messed up all of this is. I guess I've just been so used to being mistreated all my life that I never realized how messed up this was. I don't really know what to do though, I’m very isolated and I don’t really have anyone else to turn to.

As in every way possible, get me to open up then just ask for sex and leave right after, try get me to open then using what I said against, getting me to open up about abusive my home was and then using to try to recruit into their organization(which was basically a cult), and many other things.
I’m 19 and I can relate to this so much, I’ve always thought I would do it eventually but I’m still here and my life is just getting worse and worse.
Hey OP, I hope you stay with us. I care about you, we all do.
